messages.subject: ODE integrator in R-INLA?
parts:
Hi INLA developers,

As you know, solving ordinary differential equations are very relevant in fields such as pharmacometrics and ecology. Do you consider to incorporate an ODE solver to R-INLA?

Thanks in advance,

Burak Kursad Gunhan

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] ODE integrator in R-INLA?
parts:
Hi Burak,

That breaks a lot of the assumptions underlying the implementation of the method.  

I'd recommend using Stan if you're interested in solving ODE models.

Best wishes,

Dan
